inputs.brief_subject: a bright IKEA Kids bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table and poufs
inputs.brief_scene: A light room with a pine plank floor. A powder blue cotton rug with wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low flower-shaped birch craft table, a stack of ochre and barberry bouclé poufs and a low white bed with powder blue bedding. Soft afternoon light from a window on the RIGHT lies in patches on the floor. At the left edge of the frame an open white door leads into the room; a toddler girl of about two and a half in a sunny ochre knit sweater and cream trousers has just come through it and stands two steps inside the room at the left edge of the frame with her back to the camera, in mid-stride with both arms swinging out to the sides, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: pale birch, ochre, barberry red and white.
inputs.brief_framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the big pink and yellow cosmos flowers of the meadow: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.
inputs.brief_wall_rule: It covers the whole feature wall edge to edge, floor to ceiling, at its true scale, drawing and colours unchanged; nothing stands in front of it.
